piece.caption:
How to avoid paying an extraction tax on pay-per-click advertising.

When you buy search ads for a workshop or wholesale counter, platforms charge you on every click regardless of actual customer intent. The traditional ad model increasingly operates like an extraction tax on your operational margins. Instead of escalating keyword bids, structure your online catalog with exact specifications, GST terms, and delivery parameters so modern AI tools can accurately cite your inventory when qualified buyers search.

What share of your monthly ad clicks turns into actual quotation requests?
